title: Heavenly Filipino Milk Chocolate Leche Flan
description: A light and romantic Filipino dessert featuring milk chocolate and a hint of umami from nuka-pickle, made plant-based-friendly, in the form of a creamy leche flan.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Combine the coconut cream, maple syrup, vanilla extract, and salt in a blender and blend until smooth.
Melt the milk chocolate in a double boiler and whisk until smooth.
Add the nuka-pickle brine and melted milk chocolate to the coconut cream mixture and blend until well combined.
Add the agar agar powder to the mixture and blend until dissolved.
Pour the mixture into 6 ramekins or small cups.
Place the ramekins in a large baking dish and add hot water to come halfway up the sides.
Bake for 45 minutes or until set.
Remove from the oven and let cool to room temperature.
Chill in the refrigerator for at least 2 hours before serving.
